products.name: Langfuse
products.note: Open-source, framework-agnostic LLM observability: tracing, prompt management, evals, datasets; OpenTelemetry-native; acquired by ClickHouse

profile_text.body:
Langfuse is an open-source AI engineering platform designed to help teams build, monitor, and improve large language model applications. The company describes its platform as covering the full development lifecycle through tracing, prompt management, evaluations, and analytics dashboards in a single product. According to its site, Langfuse is used by more than 2,300 companies and processes billions of observations per month.

The platform captures hierarchical traces of LLM calls, tool invocations, and retrieval steps, and allows users to filter by user, session, cost, latency, or custom metadata. Langfuse describes itself as framework-agnostic and OpenTelemetry-native, with integrations spanning a wide range of tools and frameworks including LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, LiteLLM, Dify, Langflow, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, and others. The company positions the platform as built for enterprise scale, citing the verbosity of LLM input and output as a challenge that legacy observability tools cannot handle reliably.

The held facts note that Langfuse has been acquired by ClickHouse, which also appears among the integrations listed on the company's own site.
